## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run verify` is green (typecheck → tests → production build)
- [ ] New or changed mathematics has tests, including the error case
- [ ] UI changes are keyboard-reachable and labelled for screen readers
- [ ] Works down to 320 px wide and up to a wide desktop
- [ ] Still 100% free and offline: no accounts, ads, remote APIs or telemetry
- [ ] No `eval`, `new Function`, `innerHTML` or network calls added
- [ ] `PROJECT_STATUS.md` and `CHANGELOG.md` updated if behaviour or scope changed
